name: Laal Maas
instructions: 1. Soak Mathania chillies in warm water for 30 minutes and grind into a smooth paste. 2. Heat mustard oil until smoking, then temper with whole spices (bay leaf, cloves, cinnamon, cardamom). 3. Add onions and sauté until golden brown. 4. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook until the raw smell dissipates. 5. Add the mutton pieces and sear them until browned. 6. Stir in the chilli paste, coriander powder, turmeric, and salt; cook until oil separates. 7. Lower the heat and slowly incorporate the whisked yogurt. 8. Add water, cover, and slow-cook on low flame until the meat is tender and the oil floats on top.
description: Laal Maas is a legendary meat curry from Rajasthan, traditionally served to royalty. It is renowned for its intense heat and vibrant red color derived from the indigenous Mathania chillies, reflecting the rugged and bold spirit of the desert region.
